sourceSentences: [0] for Jin specifically, what you should be thinking about the most is his fourth auto attack, which does the most damage, his Q bouncing off targets onto you
[0] So, you have to be a bit away from the minions when he does this, especially when the minions die, and his W rooting you. You want to be actively trying to dodge that.

[2] Blade Whirl(W) can even nullify Jhin's Deadly Flourish. Use Jhin's final round attack when Blade Whirl(W) is on cooldown!
[2] Jhin at 50.30% and Samira at 49.70% in the head-to-head bar

audit2ans: Règle des 2 ans (audit 2026-11-12). Les tips op.gg [1] et [2] n'ont ni date ni auteur (texte éditorial « Currently, there is an in-game bug... ») : comptés comme anciens. Tips « Grenade dansante sur un sbire bas » (Jhin) et « rester loin des sbires bas » (Samira) : lane à 1 source récente, requalifiés en mécaniques vérifiées (DDragon Jhin Q : « can hit up to four targets and gains damage each time it kills ») et reformulés. Mécaniques existantes inchangées.
